changelog: - **`/admin/analytics` fits a 360px phone, and the audit that was supposed to catch it can see the page again** (#1485; #1465 verified fixed). The funnel KPI card's conversion rows are four fixed columns — a 176px label, a 96px rate, a 112px count and three 8px gaps, 408px in a 278px box — so the screen spilled ~90px at phone width, worst in German where the stage labels are longest. A phone now gets two rows per stage (label + rate above, bar + count below) and keeps every number rather than hiding the denominator; from `sm:` up it is the original single flex row, geometry unchanged (measured at 1280px: label 176 → bar 191 → rate 96 → count 112, in that order). The reason this sat open is worse than the overflow: `settle()` in the layout audit waited for the account-menu button and for zero `.animate-pulse` skeletons, but a screen that fetches one aggregate rather than a list renders a bare centred "Loading…" with no skeleton anywhere — so the poll saw zero immediately and the audit measured an **empty page**. `/admin/analytics` reported CLEAN at 360px while still spilling 89px, and every element the audit exists to check was behind that line. Those placeholders now carry `data-testid="page-loading"` (17 of them, every screen that shows one) and `settle()`/`settleStandalone()` wait for it alongside the skeletons; the walks that visit several routes are marked `test.slow()`, because they now do real waiting instead of measuring six empty pages in a few hundred milliseconds. Re-running the audit with the honest wait reproduced #1485's CI output line for line before the fix, and #1465's mentee-onboarding-wizard measured 328px box / 328px content — clean, as #2282 left it.
